select group_concat(er.VDATE ORDER BY ea.DISPENSE_PARA separator ',') distributeParameter, er.DISPENSE_RULE distributeRule, er.VDATE vdate, er.MDATE mdate from ETR_AUTO_DISPENSE_RULE er left join ETR_AUTO_DISPENSE_RULE_DETAIL ea on er.RULE_ID = ea.RULE_ID
and er.VDATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{sysDate},'%Y-%m-%d') and er.MDATE >= STR_TO_DATE(#{sysDate},'%Y-%m-%d')
group by er.DISPENSE_RULE, er.VDATE, er.MDATE
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM PA_ETR_AUTO_DISPENSE_TIME WHERE PA_ETR_AUTO_DISPENSE_TIME.VDATE <= #{entrustDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND PA_ETR_AUTO_DISPENSE_TIME.MDATE >= #{entrustDate,jdbcType=DATE}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ETR_AUTO_DISPENSE_RULE WHERE ETR_AUTO_DISPENSE_RULE.VDATE <= #{entrustDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND ETR_AUTO_DISPENSE_RULE.MDATE >= #{entrustDate,jdbcType=DATE}
select t.user_id from AUTO_DISPENSE_RIGHT t where t.asset_type=#{assetType}
select aa.asset_type trader from AUTO_DISPENSE_RIGHT aa where aa.user_id=#{trader}
